subject: Re: Scatter plot with colour of points mapped to 2d density

messages.subject: Re: Scatter plot with colour of points mapped to 2d density
parts:
What this does may not be immediately transparent, but you can use
stat_density2d in the following way to do the kde2d calculation for
you:


# Generate data
d = data.frame(x=rnorm(5000),y=rnorm(5000))

ggplot(d, aes(x=x, y=y)) +
stat_density2d(aes(size = ..density..), contour = FALSE, geom="point") +
scale_size_continuous(range=c(0.5, 3)) # Set the range of point
sizes from 0.5 to 3



If you want to generate the values with kde2d first, you'll have to
convert the output to a data frame with columns for x, y, and density,
before you can feed it to ggplot2.

# Generate density estimate with kde2d
dens <- kde2d(d$x, d$y, n = 100)

# Pull out the density matrix and set row/column names
dz <- dens$z
colnames(dz) <- dens$x
rownames(dz) <- dens$y

# Convert it to a data frame
library(reshape2)
z <- melt(dz, varnames = c("xvar", "yvar"), value.name="density")

# Plot
ggplot(z, aes(x=xvar, y=yvar, size=density)) + geom_point()

You can add this to change size of points:
scale_size_continuous(range=c(0.25, 2)) # Set the range of point
sizes from 0.25 to 2

-Winston

>

> library("MASS")

> ggplot(d, aes(x=d$x,d$y,colour=dens$z)) + geom_point(shape=".")

> This solution won't work, as the dens$z vector does not refer to the
